subject: Next steps: SLA thresholds & provisioning options for Glyph Analytics
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@glyphai.com>
Cc: Samira Patel <samira.p@glyphai.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro call — deployment needs recap and quick thresholds

Hi Jordan / Samira,

Thanks again for the time today — good conversation. As promised, a concise recap + the key question we left on the table about provisioning modes. TL;DR first: if your 99th-percentile generation latency requirement is under ~70ms at sustained ~20–30 RPS on a 1k-token context, we should evaluate Dedicated (reserved GPU pools). If you can tolerate 100–150ms p99 or have spikier traffic and want zero ops, Hosted API is likely the faster path.

Call highlights and where we landed:
- Workload: multitenant product recommendations + conversational search (mostly auto-generation with occasional long summaries ~800–1k tokens).
- Peak patterns: weekdays 9am–6pm PT with predictable spikes during batch refresh windows (~100–200 parallel requests for 2–3 minutes).
- Current constraint: must hit p99 latency target for UI interactions (target is sub-100ms ideally).
- Data requirements: no on-prem contract required initially; eventual VPC option desirable for FY27.

Open items I promised to follow up on:
1) Concrete p99 latency benchmarks for the model profiles you mentioned (we'll attach a short matrix showing p50/p90/p99 at several RPS points for 512/1k contexts).
2) Ballpark committed capacity pricing vs hosted egress cost for a baseline 30 RPS sustained profile.
3) A recommended minimal proof-of-concept (POC) plan: 2-week test with a Dedicated slot + fallback to Hosted during heavy bursts.

Next steps (proposed):
- I will loop Ben (SE) and Karthik (AE) for a quick sizing + cost estimate — target by EOD Friday.
- Jordan / Samira: please confirm your strict p99 target (is 100ms acceptable or do you need <80ms?), and the expected sustained RPS during interactive sessions (a single number or range).
- If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute follow-up next week to walk through the matrix and a sample MA plan.

Attachments: latency_matrix_v2.xlsx (benchmark matrix), MAP_demo_recording.mp4 (recording of the feature demo).

Thanks — AVA

--
Ava Chen

From: Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@glyphai.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Patel <samira.p@glyphai.com>
Date: 2026-08-13T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro call — deployment needs recap and quick thresholds

Thanks, Ava — helpful summary. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- p99 target: our product team would like p99 <= 90ms for the interactive workflow. Sub-70ms would be ideal but isn’t strictly required right now.
- Sustained RPS: for an average interactive hour we expect 18–28 RPS; during heavy experiments (monthly refresh) we might see short bursts up to 180 concurrent requests for ~5 minutes.

Two follow-ups:
1) Can you confirm whether a Dedicated slot would give us predictable p99 isolation during the short 180-rps spikes, or if we would still need autoscale burst capacity?
2) We’re open to a POC. For procurement, anything that helps speed up an internal security review (SOC2/attestation snippets, data residency notes) would be good to share up front.

-Jordan
Head of Infrastructure, Glyph Analytics

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@glyphai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Samira Patel <samira.p@glyphai.com>
Date: 2026-08-13T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro call — deployment needs recap and quick thresholds

Jordan — great, thanks for the clear targets. Short answers inline and then the plan.

1) Dedicated isolation + burst: A Dedicated pool will provide capacity isolation which reduces noisy-neighbor variance; however, for short bursts to ~180 RPS we recommend configuring a Dedicated baseline with an autoscale burst policy (reserved capacity + burst) OR a hybrid setup that uses Dedicated + fallback to Hosted for overflow. The reserved pool gives predictable p99 during sustained load, autoscale/burst covers the short spikes without overcommitting monthly.

2) Security artifacts: attaching our SOC2 summary and a short data residency note. Also sending a secure link to our attestation page in HubSpot.

Proposed POC approach (two-week):
- Week 1: Provision a Dedicated 1–2-slot test pool sized for 30 RPS sustained; run synthetic and replay traffic with your sample traces to validate p50/p90/p99.
- Week 2: Enable burst policy and run scripted spike tests to 180 RPS for 5–10 minute windows; measure routing latency and fallback behavior.

Deliverables: latency matrix (attached), cost delta estimate (will be in the Ben/Karthik note), a mutual action plan with milestones and decision gate at the end of Week 2.

Would early next Tuesday or Wednesday for a 30-min sync work for the technical runbook? I’ll have Ben on the call to walk the POC steps.

Thanks — ava

Attachment stubs: provisioning_cost_estimate.pdf, SOC2_summary.pdf

--
Ava Chen
Enterprise Sales (West) | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@glyphai.com>, Samira Patel <samira.p@glyphai.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Intro call — deployment needs recap and quick thresholds

Ava / Karthik — quick technical sizing note based on Jordan’s numbers:

- Model profile: assuming the large open LLM they referenced (context ≈1k tokens) and our quantized runtime, baseline Dedicated slot (A100-equivalent profile) yields ~60–80ms p99 at 20–30 RPS depending on prompt composition.
- For the 180 RPS 5-min spike: we recommend a Dedicated baseline sized for 30 RPS + autoscale burst to 250 RPS for short windows (burst is warm-started and routed with priority). That avoids paying for constant reserved excess while meeting spike SLOs.
- Cost note: going Dedicated baseline + limited burst runs ~35–45% higher than pure Hosted in absolute cost but gives predictable p99 and isolation for interactive UX. I attached a short cost estimate.

Action items:
- Karthik: can you produce a simple 2-line commercial (baseline commit + burst hours) we can share with procurement by EOD Monday?
- Ava: propose times for the POC runbook sync — I’m available Tue/Wed morning PT.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
